data.title: The queue screen is down!
story: This morning the queue screen at the shop went down. Log: ZeroDivisionError while the queue is still empty.
An empty queue must show an average of 0.

explanation: Dividing by len([]) = 0 crashes the program. Check for an empty list first; if the server is already failing, roll back first, then fix.
hints: Read the error type in the log: dividing by what?
Add if len(minutes) == 0: return 0 at the start.
